title: Bind commutes with suffix erasure
statement: For any types $A$ and $B$, any optional result that either fails or contains a value in $A$ paired with a bit-string suffix, and any partial continuation from suffixes to optional values in $B$, binding through the continuation applied to the suffix equals first discarding the value and then binding through the continuation.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an optional value in $A$ paired with a bit-string suffix
$f$ maps bit-string suffixes to optional values in $B$
replaced:
For an optional parse result $r$ --- either failure or a pair of a value and a
suffix --- and a partial continuation $f$ on suffixes: binding $r$ through the
function applying $f$ to the suffix component equals first discarding the value
component of $r$ and then binding through $f$.
